title: Entry Level Learning and Development Executive- Night Shift - US Process
description:
**Company Description**
Verex Engineering LLC is a multi-cloud solutions, engineering, and health care services company that helps organizations grow their business, increase efficiency, and prepare for the future. The team specializes in managing applications and infrastructure across leading cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform in a cohesive, integrated way. By solving complex technology challenges, Verex Engineering LLC creates tangible business advantages and enables clients to work faster and smarter. Its multi-cloud engineering services cover the full project lifecycle, from consultation and migration to deployment and ongoing management, with a strong focus on seamless integration, security, and compliance.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Entry Level Learning and Development Executive role for a US process, located in Rajarhat and working the night shift. The role involves supporting learning and development programs, coordinating training sessions, and assisting in onboarding initiatives for new team members. Responsibilities include maintaining training records, preparing learning materials, and supporting HR in implementing development-related policies and processes. The executive will collaborate with managers and employees to identify training needs, schedule sessions, and ensure timely completion of learning activities. Additional tasks may include preparing reports, providing administrative support to HR operations, and contributing to employee engagement initiatives.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Human Resources (HR), HR Management skills to support learning and development activities and coordinate with HR leadership.
* HR Operations and HR Policies knowledge to assist in implementing training processes and maintaining accurate documentation.
* Employee Relations skills to collaborate with teams, understand development needs, and support a positive workplace culture.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills for interacting with employees across levels and delivering training content.
* Ability to work night shifts for US processes and be present on-site in Rajarhat.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools and comfort with digital learning platforms or HRIS software.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field preferred.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and willing to learn in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

**About The University**
Swansea University is a research-led university that has been making a difference since 1920. The University community thrives on exploration and discovery and offers the right balance of excellent teaching and research, matched by an enviable quality of life.
  
  
Our stunning waterfront campuses and multicultural community make us a desirable workplace for colleagues from around the world. Our reward and benefits, and ways of working enable those who join us to have enriching careers, matched by an excellent work-life balance.
  
  
**About The Role**
Swansea University is seeking a Technician (Sport & Exercise Science) to join our Faculty Professional Services Directorate and provide high-quality technical support across teaching and research activities. Based within the Faculty of Science and Engineering, you will play a key role in ensuring Sport & Exercise Science facilities operate safely, efficiently and to a high professional standard.
  
  
Working closely with academic staff, researchers, students and fellow technicians, you will support the day-to-day delivery of practical teaching sessions, research activities and demonstrations. This includes preparing laboratories and facilities, maintaining, servicing and calibrating specialist equipment, and providing expert advice and hands‑on technical assistance to users.
  
  
You will contribute to the development and adaptation of experiments, support fieldwork and site visits when required, and assist with procurement processes to ensure equipment and materials are available when needed. A strong commitment to health, safety and sustainability is essential, as you will help promote excellent standards and ensure compliance with university policies and procedures.
  
  
As part of a collaborative, multi‑skilled technical team, you will be encouraged to share expertise across disciplines and support colleagues during busy periods or absences, helping to build resilience across the university. Swansea University is a proud signatory of the Technician Commitment, and this role offers opportunities to engage in professional development, networking and continuous skills enhancement within both the higher education and wider science & engineering sectors.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced and motivated technician to make a meaningful contribution to student experience, research excellence and technical innovation in Sport & Exercise Science.
  
  
Equality, Diversity & Inclusion
  
  
The University is committed to supporting and promoting equality and diversity in all its practices and activities. We aim to establish an inclusive environment and welcome diverse applications from the following protected characteristics: age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race (including colour, nationality, ethnic and national origin), religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation.
  
  
As an inclusive and welcoming workplace, we value people for their skills regardless of their background. Applications are welcome in Welsh and will not be treated less favourably than those submitted in English.
  
  
Welsh Language Skills
  
  
The Welsh language level required for this role is Level 1 - A little. The role holder will be able to pronounce Welsh words, answer the phone in Welsh (good morning/afternoon) and use very basic everyday words and phrases (thank you, please etc.). Level 1 can be reached by completing a 1 hour course.
  
  
The University is a proud bilingual institution, our Welsh Language Strategy outlines our aspiration to promote the language and enable our staff to engage with the language as an additional workplace skill and as a gateway to new cultural and social opportunities. Applications are welcome in Welsh and will not be treated less favourably than those submitted in English. Welsh speakers have the right to an interview in Welsh. Applicants for a role where Welsh skills are essential are expected to present their application in Welsh and will be interviewed in Welsh, if shortlisted.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Applications for this role will take the format of a CV submission and cover letter.

You will coordinate with various stakeholders, including contractors, architects, and project managers, to ensure that all aspects of the project are aligned and progressing as planned. Your expertise in site supervision will be crucial in managing on-site activities and ensuring compliance with safety regulations and engineering standards. Key responsibilities include: - Leading site execution efforts and managing day-to-day operations on construction sites. - Coordinating with project teams to ensure effective communication and collaboration. - Conducting regular site inspections to monitor progress and quality of work. - Providing technical guidance and support to junior engineers and site staff. - Ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations and standards in building construction. The successful candidate will possess strong leadership skills, excellent problem-solving abilities, and a deep understanding of civil engineering principles. You should be able to work independently and as part of a team, demonstrating a commitment to delivering high-quality results. If you are a seasoned professional with a passion for civil engineering and a desire to contribute to impactful construction projects, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

At dnata we are dedicated to assisting employees reach professional goals through development opportunities.

* Train colleagues in an efficient and cost-effective way;
* Liaise with specialist and clients to ensure relevant training and administration resources as used and updated where required;
* Assist the training team to report on training compliance, expiries and recurrence requirements;
* Assist the training team to complete sign-off processes and ensure all applicable team members meet company standards;
* Provide feedback, mentoring and support to buddy’s and SME’s
* Accountable person for completing paperwork and entering into VETrack
* Assist with training document control and document review
* Assist other ports with data entry, as required.
* Assist training department with any ad hoc duties

* VETrak experience essential
* Currently or willing to be signed off on numerous Passenger Services Functions including: PAX Assist, Check-in and Delta/Gate Supervisor
* High level of computer literacy and sound knowledge of training management systems.
* Well-developed communication skills both written and oral and negotiation skills;
* Sound understanding of the Australian Quality Training Framework and knowledge of all aspects of VET and RTO quality frameworks;

**Desirable Criteria**

* Previous experience in or knowledge of airline industry principles and procedures.

Please note that employment with dnata Airport Services Pty. Limited is conditional upon a satisfactory police/security clearance (ASIC).

title: Teammanager Regio Veluwe
description:
Geef richting aan professionals en versterk het sociaal werk op de Veluwe
   

  

 Wil jij leidinggeven aan professionals die dagelijks verschil maken voor inwoners op de Veluwe? Door uitbreiding van onze opdrachten en vacatures binnen het team teammanagers zoeken we meerdere teammanagers voor 24 tot 32 uur per week. De precieze omvang van jouw functie hangt af van de verdeling van gemeenten en teams.
   

  

 Met onze nieuwe strategie richting 2030 zetten we een duidelijke koers uit. We versterken ons vakmanschap, geven ruimte aan sociale innovatie, bouwen aan duurzame partnerschappen en maken onze maatschappelijke waarde beter zichtbaar. Lokaal waar het kan, regionaal waar het toevoegt.
   

  

 Jouw rol
   

  

 Als teammanager geef je richting aan professionals in verschillende teams en gemeenten op de Veluwe. Je helpt hen om eigenaarschap te nemen, samen te werken en resultaten te behalen. Tegelijk vertegenwoordig je Stimenz in de regio en onderhoud je relaties met gemeenten en samenwerkingspartners. Je werkt nauw samen met collega\-teammanagers en de regiomanagers aan organisatie brede vraagstukken, een herkenbare werkwijze en de verdere ontwikkeling van het sociaal werk in de regio.
   

  

 Wat ga je doen?
   

  

* Je geeft richting aan je teams en stimuleert ontwikkeling, eigenaarschap, samenwerking en kwaliteit.
* Je bewaakt doelen, afspraken en resultaten binnen contracten en subsidies.
* Je onderhoudt relaties met gemeenten, partners en andere relevante organisaties en vertegenwoordigt Stimenz in netwerken en overlegstructuren
* Je legt verbinding tussen verschillende organisaties, samenwerkingspartners en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.
* Je draagt bij aan subsidieaanvragen en legt verantwoording af over resultaten en voortgang.
* Je werkt regio\-overstijgend samen met je collega\-teammanagers en de regiomanagers aan kwaliteit, ontwikkeling en een herkenbare werkwijze binnen Stimenz.


 Dit breng je mee
   

  

* Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen teams, gemeenten en uiteenlopende belangen.
* Je houdt overzicht, maakt duidelijke keuzes en stuurt op resultaten.
* Je bent sensitief in de samenwerking met verschillende gesprekspartners, bouwt duurzame relaties op en communiceert helder.
* Je signaleert kansen en risico’s en weet ontwikkelingen in beleid en praktijk met elkaar te verbinden.
* Je werkt graag samen en draagt actief bij aan de ontwikkeling van teams en de organisatie.
* Opleiding en ervaring: je hebt minimaal hbo\+\-werk\- en \-denkniveau en bij voorkeur enkele jaren leidinggevende ervaring, liefst in het sociaal domein.


 Dit bieden wij jou
   

  

* Een functie waarin je met passie, lef en inspiratie leiding kunt geven aan teams die het verschil maken. Verder krijg je van ons:
* Een jaarcontract met de intentie deze voort te zetten voor langere tijd.
* Een salaris conform cao Sociaal Werk in functieschaal 10
* Individueel keuzebudget met daarin onder andere 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,3% eindejaarsuitkering.
* Omdat we jouw ontwikkeling belangrijk vinden, bieden wij naast de goede primaire arbeidsvoorwaarden een loopbaanbudget. En is er ruimte om je te oriënteren en ontwikkelen in het brede sociaal werk\-domein.


 Onboarding
   

  

 Wij vinden het belangrijk de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers te stimuleren en de kwaliteit van ons werk te borgen. Daarom is voor Stimenz registratie als Sociaal Werker bij Registerplein een vereiste. Ben je nog niet geregistreerd? Dan helpen we je daar actief bij in de eerste maanden na je indiensttreding.
   

  

 Voor alle nieuwe medewerkers die bij Stimenz in dienst komen is een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist. Wij vergoeden de kosten van de aanvraag.
   

  

 Enthousiast geworden?
   

  

 We ontvangen graag je motivatie en cv via de sollicitatiebutton. Wil je eerst meer informatie? Neem gerust contact op met Bianca Lubbers, Regiomanager Veluwe, via 06 30 19 39 23\.
   

  

 Over Stimenz
   

  

 Stimenz is een brede sociaal werkorganisatie op de Veluwe. We staan dichtbij mensen en sluiten in elke gemeente aan bij wat nodig is. Samen met inwoners, vrijwilligers en partners verbinden we individuele ondersteuning met de kracht van buurten en gemeenschappen, zodat iedereen zo zelfstandig, veerkrachtig en verbonden mogelijk kan leven. Iedereen telt mee. Onze missie: wij verbinden en versterken mensen en de samenlevingskracht op de Veluwe.
   

  

 Het werkgebied van Stimenz omvat de gemeenten Apeldoorn, Barneveld, Ede, Elburg, Harderwijk, Heerde, Nunspeet, Oldebroek, Putten, Renkum en Voorst.

title: Front Office Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 Front Office Executive – Educational Institute
 



**Department:** 
 Front Office / Administration
 



**Location:** 
 Barasat / Madhyamgram
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 Years
 



  





 Job Summary
 



 We are looking for a
 **professional, courteous, and well\-organized Front Office Executive** 
 to manage the reception and front\-office operations of the educational institution. The candidate will be responsible for welcoming students, parents, visitors, faculty members, and other stakeholders while ensuring smooth communication and administrative coordination.
 



 The role requires excellent communication skills, a professional attitude, strong coordination abilities, and the capability to handle multiple responsibilities efficiently.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Reception \& Visitor Management
 


* Manage the reception/front desk and ensure a professional and welcoming environment.
* Greet and assist students, parents, visitors, faculty members, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Understand visitors' requirements and direct them to the appropriate department/person.
* Maintain proper visitor records and issue visitor passes wherever applicable.
* Ensure that unauthorized persons do not access restricted areas.



 2\. Telephone \& Communication Management
 


* Attend incoming telephone calls professionally and transfer calls to the concerned department/person.
* Record and communicate messages accurately.
* Handle general enquiries through telephone, email, WhatsApp, or other official communication channels.
* Provide correct and appropriate information regarding institutional procedures, departments, working hours, admissions, and general enquiries.
* Escalate sensitive or important matters to the concerned authority.



 3\. Student \& Parent Support
 


* Assist students and parents with general queries and guide them to the appropriate department.
* Coordinate with Admission, Accounts, Academic, Examination, HR, and Administration departments whenever required.
* Maintain a courteous and helpful approach while handling complaints or concerns.
* Ensure that unresolved queries are properly followed up with the concerned department.



 4\. Administrative Support
 


* Maintain front\-office registers, records, forms, documents, and correspondence.
* Manage incoming and outgoing documents, courier, letters, and official communications.
* Maintain records of visitors, telephone calls, deliveries, and other front\-office activities.
* Assist in preparing notices, circulars, letters, and other routine administrative documents.
* Support management and administrative teams in day\-to\-day office activities.



 5\. Coordination \& Follow\-Up
 


* Coordinate with different departments for timely resolution of student, parent, visitor, and administrative requirements.
* Follow up on pending requests and communicate updates to the concerned person.
* Assist in coordinating meetings, appointments, seminars, orientations, workshops, and institutional events.
* Maintain appointment schedules and inform concerned officials about scheduled visitors or meetings.



 6\. Admissions \& Enquiry Support
 


* Handle basic admission\-related enquiries and provide approved information to prospective students and parents.
* Direct admission enquiries to the appropriate Admission team.
* Maintain records of walk\-in enquiries and visitors where required.
* Support admission\-related activities during peak admission periods and institutional events.



 7\. Documentation \& Record Management
 


* Maintain front\-office registers and ensure that all entries are updated regularly.
* Maintain proper filing of documents and correspondence.
* Ensure confidentiality of institutional and student\-related information.
* Maintain accurate records and submit reports to the reporting authority whenever required.



 8\. Office Discipline \& Front Desk Management
 


* Ensure that the reception area remains clean, organized, and professional.
* Follow institutional policies, dress code, attendance, communication, and office discipline guidelines.
* Ensure that front\-office operations remain functional during designated working hours.
* Report any operational, security, maintenance, or administrative issue to the concerned authority immediately.



 Daily Reporting \& Documentation
 



 The Front Office Executive may be required to maintain and submit:
 


* Daily visitor register.
* Incoming/outgoing communication records.
* Telephone/message records.
* Student/parent enquiry records.
* Courier and document movement records.
* Appointment/meeting records.
* Pending query/follow\-up records.
* Daily front\-office activity report, as required by management.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Professional and courteous handling of students, parents, visitors, and stakeholders.
* Accuracy and completeness of front\-office records.
* Timely response to calls, enquiries, and communications.
* Effective coordination and follow\-up with concerned departments.
* Proper maintenance of visitor and document records.
* Timely escalation of important or sensitive matters.
* Compliance with institutional rules, procedures, and reporting requirements.
* Overall efficiency and discipline of front\-office operations.



 Educational Qualification
 


* Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
* Diploma/Certificate in Office Administration, Hospitality, Customer Service, or a related field and from educational sector will be an advantage.



 Required Skills
 


* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, email, internet, and basic computer applications.
* Strong interpersonal and customer\-service skills.
* Good telephone etiquette.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Professional appearance and courteous personality.
* Good command of English and Bengali/Hindi will be an advantage.



 Preferred Experience
 


* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in front\-office, reception, administration, customer service, or a similar role.
* Experience in an
 **educational institution, school, college, hospital, corporate office, or service organization** 
 will be preferred.



 Key Competencies
 



**Communication \| Customer Service \| Coordination \| Documentation \| Visitor Management \| Time Management \| Problem Solving \| Professionalism \| Confidentiality \| Administrative Support** 




 Working Requirements
 


* Willingness to support institutional events, admission activities, orientations, meetings, and other official programs as required.
* Ability to maintain professional conduct and discipline at all times.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and stakeholders.
* Flexibility to handle additional administrative responsibilities assigned by the management.

title: Daglig leder til Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave
description:
Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave er en hyggelig privat institution med omkring 20 dejlige skovbørn, hvor der er masser af hjertevarme, glæde og fællesskab.
   

  

 Institutionen blev grundlagt i 1970 og har i dag base i Stenløse Egedal Kommune. Hver dag, året rundt kører vi på eventyr i skov og ved strand i vores trofaste bus ”Rumle”. Vi bruger alt vores tid ude, og vores mål er at lære børnene at færdes i naturen, vise dem hvor givende naturen er, med bl.a. læring om respekt for dyr og plantelivet.
   

  

 Nærvær og indlevelse, glæde og latter er det centrale omdrejningspunkt i vores hverdag. Vi sætter en ære i at alle har haft en god dag, når de går hjem.
   

  

 Du vil blive leder for en dynamisk og engageret personalegruppe med hver deres kompetencer, som har et tæt samarbejde – både blandt hinanden, men også med forældregruppen og bestyrelsen. Vores værdier og menneskesyn udspringer af anerkendelse og respekt over for hinanden – store som små, og at møde barnet der hvor det er, og bidrage til selvværd og selvudvikling hos det enkelte barn. Vi bruger alle rammerne i naturen til at skabe læring, sjov og glæde. Vi har særlig fokus på leg, bevægelse, kreativitet og sociale fællesskaber samt børneyoga og mindfulness.
   

  

 Personaleledelse, administration og samarbejde
   

  

 Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave består af en personalegruppe på 4 personer og mellem 20 og 30 skønne skovbørn. Du skal have overblik, være struktureret og god til at samarbejde. Jobbet indebærer en række administrative opgaver, herunder budgetansvar, ugeplanlægning, ventelistehåndtering, opfølgning, personale\- og forældresamtaler, svare henvendelser på mail og telefon mv. Økonomi og administration vil foregå i tæt dialog med bestyrelsen og Landsorganisationen Danske Daginstitutioner – LDD som vi er medlem af.
   

  

 Arbejdet vil være fordelt således, at der i gennemsnit er 2 faste dage om ugen til kontor og de resterende dage er du med i skoven.
   

  

 Profil
   

  

* Du er uddannet pædagog og har gerne erfaring ledelse fra tidligere job.
* Du skal kunne lide at færdes i naturen og har flair for udelivet.
* Du har økonomisk overblik, arbejder struktureret og har it\-forståelser.
* Du skal kunne bevæge dig i krydsfeltet mellem at være på børn og være leder.
* Du besidder empati og kan skabe tryghed og omsorg for det enkelte barn og gruppen som helhed.
* Du kan udvise ansvarlighed overfor børnehavens værdier og koncept.
* Du kan samarbejde med åben dialog, forståelse og tydelig kommunikation.
* Du kan inspirere og er god til sparring og opbygge et positivt samarbejdsklima.


 Vi søger dig, som har lyst til at indgå i et spændende og givende job, hvor du vil få stor indflydelse på, at vores børn får den bedste start på livet ved at gå i en skovbørnehave.
   

  

 Stillingen er på 37 timer og til besættelse snarest muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Frist for ansøgning er 14\. oktober 2026\.
   

  

 Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, kan du ringe til vores formand Cecilie Wium\-Tellefsen på 28 15 95 13\.
   

  

 Din ansøgning sendes til formand@skovboernehave.dk, og du bedes vedhæfte CV, uddannelsespapirer, kursusbeviser, udtalelser, referencer og/eller andre relevante papirer.
   

  

 Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning!

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT KEI** 

 Kingston Educational Institute (KEI) is a multi\-disciplinary education group in West Bengal. Its institutions include Kingston Law College, Kingston College of Advanced Engineering \& Management, Kingston Polytechnic College, Kingston School of Management \& Science, Kingston College of Science, KET Nursing, Kingston Teachers' Training College and Kingston Model School, along with Kingston General Hospital. KEI's main campus is in Barasat, with a corporate office in Madhyamgram and branch offices in Tamluk, Agartala and Malda.
 


**ROLE PURPOSE** 

 The Senior Manager – Accounts \& Finance will head the complete accounts and finance function across KEI's colleges, school, branch offices and Kingston General Hospital. This is a hands\-on leadership role: the incumbent must be able to personally perform every accounting, statutory filing and reporting task, while leading a team of 7–10 accountants, cashiers and purchase executives. The role is accountable for accurate books, trust and society compliance (including 12A/12AB and 80G), timely statutory and financial payments, audit readiness, MIS reporting to management, and strong relationships with banks and financial institutions.
 


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

**1\. Hands\-on Accounting \& Statutory Filings** 




 •   Personally carry out, review and correct all entries in Tally Prime and the ERP: vouchers, receipts, payments and journals.
 



 •   Prepare and file GST returns (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-9/9C), reconcile input credit with GSTR\-2B, and respond to GST notices.
 



 •   Compute, deposit and file TDS returns (24Q, 26Q), issue Form 16/16A, and resolve TRACES defaults.
 



 •   Calculate, pay and file PF, ESI and Professional Tax, and handle related inspections and queries.
 



 •   Step in for any team member's work during absences, peak periods or audits.
 



**2\. Accounts Finalisation \& Audit** 




 •   Lead year\-end finalisation for all entities: balance sheet, income \& expenditure / P\&L, schedules and notes.
 



 •   Prepare finalisation schedules, reconciliations and audit working papers directly, not only through the team.
 



 •   Coordinate statutory, internal and tax audits, and close audit observations within agreed timelines.
 



 •   Consolidate accounts across colleges, school, hospital and branch offices.
 



**3\. Accounts Receivable – Education \& Hospital** 




 •   Oversee student fee collection, receivables tracking and reconciliation, including scholarships, education loans and refunds.
 



 •   Manage hospital receivables: patient billing, TPA/insurance claims, and corporate and government scheme dues.
 



 •   Maintain receivable ageing reports and drive follow\-up on overdue amounts.
 



**4\. Accounts Payable \& Financial Liabilities** 




 •   Control vendor payments, bill verification, expense approvals and vendor reconciliations.
 



 •   Work with the purchase team on purchase orders, GRNs and payment terms.
 



 •   Ensure timely payment of all financial liabilities, including loan EMIs, interest, lease and vendor dues.
 



**5\. Statutory Obligations \& Salary Disbursement** 




 •   Ensure 100% on\-time payment of statutory dues: GST, TDS, PF, ESI, Professional Tax and income tax.
 



 •   Manage monthly payroll accounting and on\-schedule salary disbursement for teaching, non\-teaching and hospital staff.
 



 •   Maintain financial records required by regulators and affiliating bodies (AICTE, MAKAUT, WBSU, INC and others).
 



**6\. Trust, Society \& Income\-Tax Exemption Compliance (12A/12AB, 80G)** 




 •   Maintain books of accounts in line with the trust deed / society bye\-laws and applicable accounting requirements for charitable institutions.
 



 •   Manage registration, renewal and continued compliance under Sections 12A/12AB and 80G of the Income Tax Act, including Form 10A/10AB applications.
 



 •   Ensure timely audit and filing of Form 10B/10BB, ITR\-7 and related income\-tax compliances for the trust/society.
 



 •   Track application of income and accumulation requirements, and file Form 9A / Form 10 where applicable.
 



 •   Manage 80G donation compliance: donor records, Form 10BD statements and Form 10BE certificates.
 



 •   Handle annual filings and record\-keeping under the West Bengal Societies Registration Act, 1961 (Registrar of Firms, Societies \& Non\-Trading Corporations), including accounts, governing body resolutions and member records as required.
 



 •   Coordinate with the tax consultant and auditors on assessments, notices and exemption\-related queries.
 



**7\. MIS Reporting \& Financial Planning** 




 •   Prepare monthly and quarterly MIS: unit\-wise income, expenses, collections, cash position and variance analysis.
 



 •   Prepare annual budgets and cash\-flow forecasts, and track actuals against budget.
 



 •   Track cost centres and profitability by institution and by hospital department.
 



 •   Design and enforce internal controls, approval matrices and accounting policies.
 



**8\. Team Leadership \& Cross\-Department Coordination** 




 •   Lead, allocate work to, train and review a team of 7–10 accountants, cashiers and purchase executives.
 



 •   Coordinate with Admissions, HR, Purchase, Hospital Administration and academic departments on all finance matters.
 



**9\. Banking \& Financial Institution Relationships** 




 •   Manage relationships with banks, NBFCs and other financial institutions for term loans, working capital, overdraft limits and education\-loan tie\-ups.
 



 •   Handle bank reconciliations, fund management and documentation for credit facilities and renewals.
 


**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 

**Must\-have** 




 •   B.Com / M.Com.
 



 •   8–12 years in accounts \& finance, including 3–4 years leading a team.
 



 •   Hands\-on expertise in accounts finalisation for multi\-unit entities.
 



 •   Has personally filed GST, TDS, PF, ESI and Professional Tax returns and handled department notices.
 



 •   Expert in Tally Prime and ERP systems, including masters, cost centres and reports.
 



 •   Advanced MS Excel: XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, Power Query and MIS dashboards.
 



 •   Experience dealing with banks and financial institutions.
 



 •   Working knowledge of trust and society accounting, and hands\-on compliance under Sections 12A/12AB and 80G (Form 10A/10AB, 10B/10BB, ITR\-7, 10BD/10BE).
 



**Good\-to\-have** 




 •   Hospital accounting \& finance experience (patient billing, TPA/insurance claims, pharmacy and inventory accounting) – strongly preferred.
 



 •   CA Inter, CMA Inter or MBA (Finance).
 



 •   Experience in an educational trust/society or multi\-unit organisation.
 



 •   Fluency in English and Bengali.
 



  




**KEY COMPETENCIES** 

 •   
 **Integrity \& Confidentiality –** 
 integrity and discretion with sensitive financial and salary data.
 



 •   
 **Hands\-on Leadership –** 
 leads from the front and is comfortable doing the work, not only reviewing it.
 



 •   
 **Compliance Mindset –** 
 disciplined about deadlines, accuracy and documentation.
 



 •   
 **Stakeholder Management –** 
 works well with management, department heads, auditors and bankers.
 



 •   
 **People Development –** 
 builds team capability through training, delegation and feedback.
 



  




**WHY JOIN KEI** 

 •   Lead the full finance function of a multi\-institution education group with its own hospital.
 



 •   Work directly with top management, with high visibility and ownership.
 



 •   Build and strengthen finance systems, controls and reporting across units.
